key_insight: A neuro-symbolic AI system can automate complex pathology quality abstraction from narrative reports by combining language-model extraction with rule-based reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This could reduce manual chart-review burden and make more clinically meaningful quality measures feasible to measure at scale in pathology workflows.
method: Decomposed each quality measure into atomic questions.
Used case-based refinement with human-in-the-loop alignment to real-world pathology reports.
Compared NSAI against trained human abstractors on four CAP pathology quality measures.
evidence_signal: In 2,000 independently double-abstracted reports, NSAI matched or slightly exceeded trained human abstractors versus the adjudicated gold standard (kappa 0.95 vs 0.92).
watch_item: Performance was evaluated on specific CAP pathology measures, so broader generalization and workflow integration still need validation.
paper_title: Neuro-Symbolic AI for Automated Pathology Quality Measurement
